description: Defines the AjaxResponse class which encapsulates the structure of an AJAX response, including status, data, validation messages, and JSON serialization logic.

classes.name: AjaxResponse
classes.description: A class representing an AJAX response with status, data, validation messages, and JSON serialization.

methods.name: getValidationMessages
methods.description: Returns the map of validation messages.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns the list of data entries.

methods.name: addDataEntry
methods.description: Adds a data entry map to the data list.

methods.name: addEntry
methods.description: Adds a key-value pair to the data map.

methods.name: setErrorMessage
methods.description: Sets an error message based on Throwable.

methods.name: setErrorString
methods.description: Sets an error message from a string.

methods.name: addValidationMessage
methods.description: Adds a validation message for a specific field.

methods.name: getJsonInfo
methods.description: Constructs a JSON string with basic response info (status and statusMessage).

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Serializes the entire AjaxResponse object to a JSON string, including data, validation messages, and validation info.
